therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Immunocytokine targeting GD2 ganglioside with IL-2 fusion for immune activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Anti-tumor immune response via GD2-targeted IL-2 delivery
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Resectable recurrent stage III or stage IV melanoma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Recurrence Free Survival and Overall Survival

results.effect_size: Median RFS 5.73 months, Median OS 61.57 months
results.target_engagement_evidence: GD2 expression detected in 6/12 evaluable patients (50% positive)
biomarker_changes: CRP increased from baseline 0 mg/dL to peak 9-11 mg/dL at cycle 1 day 3
Lymphocyte count decreased from baseline ~1600 to nadir ~225 at cycle 1 day 3, then rebounded to ~4400 at cycle 1 day 8
Soluble IL-2 receptor alpha increased from baseline ~1260 ng/ml to peak ~11000-14000 ng/ml during treatment cycles
Anti-idiotypic antibodies developed with peak optical density 1.5-1.7 at cycle 1 day 8
subgroup_findings: GD2 positive patients: 3/11 in arm A, 3/9 in arm B
GD2 negative patients: 3/11 in arm A, 3/9 in arm B
safety_signals: Lymphopenia was the most common serious adverse event
Headache, vomiting, infection, and neuropathy reported as serious adverse events

dose_info.schedule: IV on days 1, 2, and 3 of a 28-day course

context.indication: Resectable recurrent stage III or stage IV melanoma
context.comparator: None (single-arm study with two treatment sequences)
